result.title: STeP-C: Real-Time Neural Compression for Distributed Fiber-Optic Sensing at Scale
result.comment: Accepted to WACV 2027 (Applications Track). 10 pages, 9 figures, 3 tables
result.summary: Distributed fiber-optic sensing (DFOS) technologies such as Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) generate continuous, high-resolution spatio-temporal data at rates exceeding hundreds of megabytes per second, creating severe challenges for real-time storage and transmission. While neural compression methods can achieve strong rate-distortion performance on sensing data, prior approaches either require per-segment retraining incompatible with streaming, or have only been validated offline. None have been demonstrated end-to-end on a continuously streaming DAS acquisition system at scale. We present STeP-C (Spatio-Temporal Predictive Compression), a neural compression framework that decouples spatial encoding, temporal prediction, and entropy-optimized residual coding, trained end-to-end with a rate-distortion objective motivated by conditional entropy reduction. Critically, we identify entropy coding as the dominant bottleneck for streaming deployment. We address it through GPU-side symbol computation, cached probability tables, and parallel GIL-free arithmetic coding, together with FP16 inference and batched entropy coding, enabling a full real-time pipeline built around a GPU ring buffer. We validate this pipeline on a live DAS testbed, achieving a 98.85% file size reduction at 31.04 dB full-band PSNR and an average throughput of 535 MB/s, exceeding the 324 MB/s requirement for 1 kHz, 81 km DAS streams. We further show that STeP-C substantially outperforms conventional codecs at practical streaming bitrates, can be applied to unseen channel ranges within the same acquisition system without retraining, and largely maintains downstream detector consistency, with 96.62% high-confidence class agreement and 100% Jaccard similarity on detected event types.

AI.brief_summary: 本文提出 STeP-C，一个面向分布式光纤声学传感（DAS）流式数据的神经压缩框架，将空间编码、时间预测与熵编码残差压缩解耦，并通过 GPU 符号计算、缓存概率表、无 GIL 算术编码与 FP16 推理实现实时流水线。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作属传感信号压缩与工程吞吐优化，虽含「时间预测」「熵编码」等词，但压缩预测状态与 LVR/VLM 推理中的 latent 推理状态、证据获取与停止决策无实质联系，也无具体可借鉴线索。
